name: Brave Hunter Aoi
original_name: ブレイブハンターあおい
source:
One day, they suddenly appeared out of nowhere. They dominate humans with violence, wielding inhuman power, and are growing into a massive structure. They are an evil organization called Nemesis.

Its influence gradually spread, and people began to live their lives, shuddering in fear. However, as if in accord with Nemesis, allies of justice also appeared and turned into a resistance force, obstructing its uprising. The girls simply keep fighting with the organization to help the people without ever revealing their identities.

On a certain day, Kagami Aoi came across a mysterious man who was fleeing from the clutches of Nemesis. Just as they were driven to a corner, the man gave her an odd inquiry: "If you have the courage to fight, chant "Brave Ignition"." Fate has chosen the girl. And so she reached out to it as well.

[b]"Brave Ignition!"[/b]

[Translated from the [url=http://crossover-game.jp/include/aoi/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
有一天，他们突然凭空出现。他们以暴力统治人类，掌握着非人的力量，并且正在成长为一个巨大的结构。他们是一个名为复仇女神的邪恶组织。

它的影响逐渐蔓延，人们开始在恐惧中颤抖着生活。然而，正如涅墨西斯所言，正义的盟友也出现了，并化作抵抗力量，阻挠其起义。女孩们只是继续与该组织斗争以帮助人们，而从未透露自己的身份。

某一天，镜葵遇到了一名正在逃离涅墨西斯魔掌的神秘男子。正当他们被逼到墙角时，男人奇怪地询问了她：“如果你有勇气去战斗，就唱《勇敢的点火》。”命运选择了这个女孩。所以她也伸出了援手。

[b]“勇敢的点火！”[/b]

[翻译自[url=http://crossover-game.jp/include/aoi/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
